subject: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps

Alex — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps focused on performance/SLO items so we can validate fit before a POC:

Summary of demo highlights
- Streaming chat with function calls (demo used redwood-v2-stream)
- On-host latency: demo average p50 ~65ms, p95 ~210ms for 1k-token sequences (demo conditions)

FintechCo performance asks we captured
- Latency target: P95 <= 200ms for single-turn streaming responses (critical)
- Throughput: sustained 150-200 req/s during peak windows
- Concurrency: support 40-60 concurrent sessions with KV-cache warm
- Streaming: chunked streaming with incremental tokens (client-side assembly)

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan)
1) Redwood: run targeted perf benchmark on FintechCo sample workload (model variants + quantization) — deliverables: perf spreadsheet + recommended config (due: 2027-06-24)
2) FintechCo: provide representative prompt set and expected token-length distribution (due: 2027-06-22)
3) Joint: 1-week POC (dedicated pool / reserved capacity) based on benchmark results (target start: 2027-07-01)
4) Decision: sign or decline POC within 5 business days after POC end (decision criteria: p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, stability under concurrency)

Action items for you / ask
- Please confirm the latency (P95 <= 200ms) and concurrency numbers above, and whether streaming must be byte-chunked vs. token-chunked (we support both but want to validate client expectations).

Attachments: fintechco-map-20270620.pdf (MAP + timelines)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the MAP together.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 18:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency: P95 <= 200ms is our current internal goal for interactive features. If you can consistently hit P95 <= 180ms in the benchmark that would be ideal.
- Throughput: planning for 180 req/s sustained, with short spikes to 250 req/s during batch processing windows.
- Concurrency: 50 concurrent sessions is a good planning number.
- Streaming: token-chunked streaming preferred (client uses token reassembly). We can handle small out-of-order chunks but prefer token boundaries.

Also looping in procurement (procurement@fintechco.com) — we'll need a simple SOW/estimate for a 2-week POC and an NDA if not already in place.

Confirming we'll upload a representative prompt set by Tue 6/22. Can Redwood provide a benchmark plan so our infra team knows what to expect network/egress wise?

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Platform Integrations, FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Can we:
- Run our perf harness against their prompt set when they upload (target 6/22) and validate P95 under both quantized and fp16 model variants.
- Produce a short benchmark runbook they can host-side (egress/ports + expected ephemeral traffic) so Alex's infra team knows what to expect.
- Provide initial estimate for dedicated pool sizing and a quick SOW for a 2-week POC.

Deliverables I promised to Alex: perf-estimate.xlsx + benchmark runbook + SOW. Can we aim to have the perf spreadsheet and runbook to Alex by 6/24 EOD? PoC start target 7/1 if results look good.

I'll attach the MAP doc (fintechco-map-20270620.pdf) and include the HubSpot deal id (HUB-2345) in the notes.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps

Marissa — noted. Quick update:

- We can meet the p95 <= 200ms target on redwood-v2-medium-q4 for token-chunked streaming in a dedicated pool with warm KV cache for the expected token lengths (based on similar customers). We should be able to hit ~160-180ms p95 in controlled runs.
- Throughput: a 4-GPU dedicated pool (A100-equivalent) should comfortably sustain 180 req/s with headroom to 250 spikes if we enable dynamic batching and prewarmed workers. Exact sizing will depend on average token counts; I'll quantify in the spreadsheet.
- Streaming: we support token-boundary chunked streaming with small assembly metadata so FintechCo can rehydrate reliably.

Attaching: perf-estimate.xlsx (initial draft). I'll run the full benchmark once they upload the prompt set.

Will also draft a short SOW for a 2-week POC and a concise runbook for their infra team (egress/ports, expected peak bandwidth). Targeting to get these to Alex by Thu 6/24 EOD.

- Aditya

Attachment: perf-estimate.xlsx (stubs included)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>

Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO recap & next steps

Thanks team — plan looks good. A couple quick decision-criteria confirmations so we're aligned before the POC:

1) P95 latency <= 200ms (preferred <= 180ms) for token-chunked streaming during simulated peak traffic
2) Sustained cost estimate for our expected volume (provide cost per 1M tokens and expected monthly cost projection)
3) No functional regressions versus current baseline (we'll validate with existing prompt set)
4) Smooth integration: runbook + network requirements must be clear for our infra team

Procurement will expect the SOW + estimate to review for an expedited PO. If you can include a short clause about data handling (no persistent storage of prompt content, audit logs kept per agreement), that will help speed review.

Alex
